component.name: ProbeScene
component.script:
sub init() m.nav = m.top.findNode("nav") m.stack = m.top.findNode("stack") m.nav.observeField("lastKey", "onKey") m.seq = 0 m.cases = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F", "G", "H", "I", "J", "L", "M"] m.caseIndex = 0 m.step = 0 m.waitKey = false m.waitTicks = 0 print "PROBE|000|boot|start|" m.tick = m.top.findNode("tick") m.tick.observeField("fire", "onTick") m.tick.control = "start" end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as string, press as boolean) as boolean if press then reportKey("scene:" + key) return press end function
sub onKey(event as object) reportKey(event.getData()) end sub
sub reportKey(who as string) if m.waitKey then m.waitKey = false p("key", "got=" + who) end if end sub
function nextSeq() as string m.seq = m.seq + 1 s = m.seq.toStr() while len(s) < 3 s = "0" + s end while return s end function
sub p(stage as string, extra = "" as string) line = "PROBE|" + nextSeq() + "|" + m.case + "|" + stage + "| nav=" + m.nav.hasFocus().toStr() if m.view <> invalid then line = line + " view=" + m.view.hasFocus().toStr() + " viewChain=" + m.view.isInFocusChain().toStr() + " child=" + m.child.hasFocus().toStr() + " childChain=" + m.child.isInFocusChain().toStr() end if print line + " links=" + links() + " " + extra end sub
sub askKey() m.waitKey = true m.waitTicks = 0 print "PROBE|" + nextSeq() + "|await|Play|" end sub
function links() as string s = "" node = m.top for i = 0 to 10 fc = node.focusedChild if fc = invalid then return s + "/-" if fc.isSameNode(node) then return s + "/self" s = s + "/" + fc.id node = fc end for return s end function
sub onTick() if m.waitKey then m.waitTicks = m.waitTicks + 1 if m.waitTicks < 15 then return m.waitKey = false p("key", "got=none") end if if m.caseIndex >= m.cases.count() then m.tick.control = "stop" print "PROBE|" + nextSeq() + "|done|" return end if m.case = m.cases[m.caseIndex] runStep() m.step = m.step + 1 end sub
sub runStep() s = m.step if s = 0 then m.stack.removeChildrenIndex(m.stack.getChildCount(), 0) m.view = invalid m.nav.setFocus(true) if m.case = "C" then m.nav.setFocus(false) createView() if m.case = "F" then fillRow() p("created") else if s = 1 then p("created-next-tick") askKey() else if s = 2 then if m.case <> "D" then m.stack.appendChild(m.view) m.view.reparent(m.stack, true) if m.case = "L" then m.nav.setFocus(true) if m.case = "M" then m.view.setFocus(true) end if p("mounted") else if s = 3 then p("mounted-next-tick") if m.case = "E" or m.case = "G" or m.case = "H" or m.case = "I" or m.case = "J" or m.case = "L" or m.case = "M" then fillRow() p("filled") end if askKey() else if s = 4 then p("after-key") m.nav.setFocus(true) p("nav-focused") m.caseIndex = m.caseIndex + 1 m.step = -1 end if end sub
sub createView() if m.case = "B" then m.view = CreateObject("roSGNode", "KeyGroup") m.view.consume = false m.view.id = "view" m.child = CreateObject("roSGNode", "KeyGroup") m.child.id = "child" m.view.appendChild(m.child) m.child.setFocus(true) else if m.case = "E" or m.case = "F" or m.case = "L" or m.case = "M" then m.view = CreateObject("roSGNode", "RowView") m.view.id = "view" m.child = m.view.findNode("child") else if m.case = "H" or m.case = "I" or m.case = "J" then m.view = CreateObject("roSGNode", "KeyGroup") m.view.consume = false m.view.focusable = false m.view.id = "view" if m.case = "J" then m.view.visible = false listType = "RowList" if m.case = "H" then listType = "LabelList" if m.case = "I" then listType = "MarkupGrid" m.child = CreateObject("roSGNode", listType) m.child.id = "child" if listType = "RowList" then m.child.itemComponentName = "SimpleItem" m.child.itemSize = [600, 100] m.child.rowItemSize = [[200, 100]] m.child.numRows = 1 else if listType = "MarkupGrid" then m.child.itemComponentName = "SimpleItem" m.child.itemSize = [200, 100] m.child.numColumns = 2 m.child.numRows = 1 end if m.child.content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") m.child.setFocus(true) m.view.appendChild(m.child) else if m.case = "G" then m.view = CreateObject("roSGNode", "PlainRowView") m.view.id = "view" m.child = m.view.findNode("child") else m.view = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ChildView") m.view.id = "view" m.child = m.view.findNode("child") end if m.view.observeField("lastKey", "onKey") if m.child.hasField("lastKey") then m.child.observeField("lastKey", "onKey") end sub
sub fillRow() content = CreateObject("roSGNode", "ContentNode") if m.child.subtype() = "LabelList" or m.child.subtype() = "MarkupGrid" then content.createChild("ContentNode").title = "one" content.createChild("ContentNode").title = "two" else row = content.createChild("ContentNode") row.createChild("ContentNode") row.createChild("ContentNode") end if m.child.content = content end sub
